description: The blend kernels of the evaluator (04 section 3, tasks phase1.10_compositor-blend-kernels and phase1.11_compositor-blend-gaps) for every documented BlendingMode, evaluated by the CPU store under the current profile on the Tier 0 blend sweeps, on the hue grid of the component modes, on the normal-map modes off the recorded opacities and on flat normals, on the Normal channel and on the UI-set Passthrough groups. Residuals are |delta| in export units (16-bit PNG codes, OpenEXR float32 values) per texture set and channel, against both recordings (r1 same session, r2 after save and reopen). Supersedes blend-modes.json for the evaluator; blend-modes.json keeps the phase0.7 candidate fits.

entries.subject: BlendingMode.Normal in the evaluator
entries.formula: Normal, per channel in float32 (fma: one rounding): r = b. Opacity alpha (times the mask): over an opaque backdrop v = a (1 - alpha) + r alpha, the products rounded and summed in float32; over a transparent backdrop the source; else W3C §5.1. UNORM formats clamp r to [0, 1] first. Operands and writes per channel format as in quantisation-profile.json (isolated root, sRGB8 on linear values).

public_sources.locator: Floating-point rules: rcp, sqrt, rsqrt within 1 ULP; FLOAT to UNORM, FLOAT to FLOAT16

entries.subject: BlendingMode.Divide in the evaluator

Opacity alpha (times the mask): over an opaque backdrop v = a (1 - alpha) + r alpha, the products rounded and summed in float32; over a transparent backdrop the source; else W3C §5.1. entries.subject: BlendingMode.Tint in the evaluator
entries.formula: Tint: f = HSV(hue of B, saturation and value of A) with the value doubled, in float32 (fitted, phase1.11): hue in turns from the smallest component (red first, then green before blue on ties), centre C = 1 (blue), 3 (red), 5 (green) and p, q the other two (g and r, b and g, r and b): h6 = fma(p - (q + 3e), rcp(d + e), C), d = max - min, e = 2^-12, h = h6 float32(1/6), plus 1 if negative (1 itself kept); hue weights centred on the primaries: red fma(6, |h - 1/2|, -1), green fma(-6, |h - 1/3|, 2), blue fma(-6, |h - 2/3|, 2) with 1/3 and 2/3 as float32, clamped to [0, 1]; v = 2 max, lo = v fma(-d', rcp(max' + e), 1) of the saturation source (d', max'; Saturation: 1 - d' rcp(max' + e) with two roundings), each component fma(v - lo, w, lo). A grey channel keeps A (Value: B). Opacity alpha (times the mask): over an opaque backdrop v = a (1 - alpha) + r alpha, the products rounded and summed in float32; over a transparent backdrop the source; else W3C §5.1. UNORM formats clamp r to [0, 1] first. Operands and writes per channel format as in quantisation-profile.json (isolated root, sRGB8 on linear values). Divisions and roots use the recording GPU's float32 results (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, D3D12): the correctly rounded value moved by -2..+1 ulp from tables measured over every float32 mantissa (src/evaluator/hwmath.h; uzp-evaluator-tests fp-hardware), on the CPU and on every GPU alike.

entries.subject: BlendingMode.NormalMapCombine in the evaluator (user channels and the Normal channel)
entries.formula: NormalMapCombine: a, b = normalise(2c - 1) with z clamped to >= 0, normalise(v) = v rsqrt(fma(z, z, fma(x, x, y y))); below opacity 1, b is first rotated toward (0, 0, 1) by the opacity alpha (fitted, phase1.11): t = float32(pi/2) - asin(z), z clamped to [0, 1], with the recording GPU's GLSL arcsine (Vulkan and OpenGL; D3D12 differs); b' = (b.x k, b.y k, cos(alpha t)), k = sin(alpha t) rsqrt(fma(-z, z, 1)), sine and cosine the GPU's (table index floor(2^25 trunc(x float32(1/(2 pi))))); a flat b (z = 1) is kept; whiteout r = (a.xy + b.xy, a.z b.z): t = base + (0, 0, 1), u = detail (-1, -1, 1), d = fma(t.z, u.z, fma(t.y, u.y, t.x u.x)), r.xy = fma(t.xy, d, -(u.xy t.z)), r.z = t.z (d - u.z); result fma(normalise(r), 1/2, 1/2), written as it is over an opaque backdrop (the opacity enters only through the rotation). A grey channel takes B. Divisions and roots use the recording GPU's float32 results (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, D3D12): the correctly rounded value moved by -2..+1 ulp from tables measured over every float32 mantissa (src/evaluator/hwmath.h; uzp-evaluator-tests fp-hardware), on the CPU and on every GPU alike. entries.subject: BlendingMode.PassThrough (group layers only; the runtime member is Passthrough)
entries.formula: A PassThrough group composites its visible children onto a copy of the accumulator below it, each child stored in the channel format with its own mode, opacity and mask, and then moves the accumulator toward that result by the group's opacity t times its mask: v = fma(g - a, t, a) over an opaque backdrop (one rounding); over a transparent backdrop the result with coverage t times its coverage; between, the premultiplied lerp (not recorded). Set through Painter's UI (decision 029); the documented BlendingMode.PassThrough does not exist at runtime.
entries.notes: Fitted on tier0/semantics-ui/group-passthrough-masks s0-s3 (no mask, a group mask, a child mask, both; RGB16, sRGB8 and RGB32F); its Normal-mode controls s4-s7 are the group-masks stack. The scaled-children hypothesis of phase1.4 is refuted.
